newsitem.title: ITALY: Turkish ship rescued, no reports of victims.
newsitem.headline: Turkish ship rescued, no reports of victims.

text.p: A ship carrying some 100 illegal immigrants was rescued by the coastguard after getting into difficulties off the coast of southern Italy on Friday, officials said.
There were no immediate reports of victims in the incident off the Puglia coast. Rescue vessels were towing the ship to the port of Gallipoli.
An official at the coastguard command in Rome said the ship had a hole in its side and had taken on water.
He said there were no immediate reports of victims among the passengers, believed to be Iranians and Sri Lankans trying to enter Italy illegally.
The name and home port of the ship were not immediately known.
The ship, believed to be about 30 metres (100 ft) long, had sent out an distress signal reporting that it was starting to sink.
Officials had originally said that some 150 illegal immigrants were believed to be on board.
